answer: Deposits are visible in summit, and whisper reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an farming party cannot recycle one pool of capital across 67 aliases, and each one needs its own funded atlas account. A bond of 30% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. The attacker spends 23 dollars and 10 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
